definitions.gloss: reserve; hesitation; restraint out of consideration for others
definitions.explanation: Holding back or feeling constrained because of concern about troubling, inconveniencing, or offending others. A characteristically Japanese social concept where one restrains oneself to maintain harmony.

examples.japanese: {気兼|きが}ね⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{話|はな}せる→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have a friend I can talk to without holding back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣人|りんじん}→隣人：10007_rinjin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気兼|きが}ね⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えている→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
examples.english: Out of consideration for my neighbors, I refrain from playing music at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気兼|きが}ね⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一人暮|ひとりぐ}らし→一人暮らし：03142_hitorigurashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧だ。
examples.english: Living at my parents' house means constantly holding back, so living alone is easier.

notes:
USAGE:
{気兼|きが}ね reflects a deeply Japanese social dynamic of self-restraint out of concern for others' feelings or comfort. The most common form is {気兼|きが}ね⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without reserve), used to describe relationships or situations where one can be completely at ease. As a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb, {気兼|きが}ね⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to hold back out of consideration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気兼|きが}ね⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without reserve, freely
- {気兼|きが}ね⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hold back, to feel constrained
- {気兼|きが}ね⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend time without restraint
- {気兼|きが}ね⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: a relationship without reserve
